documents.population: International applicants (foreign nationals) to undergraduate programmes
documents.notes: 'List of Uploading Documents in the Online Application System (for International applicants of Undergraduate Programs)', linked from the Application Procedures page; its dates are the 2026 cycle's (passport valid after 1 October 2026, graduation by August 2026), while the Eligibility page refers to the 2027 nationality instructions and age on 1 September 2027. Not drafted (no vocabulary kind): parents' passports and visa/entry-stamp pages, HSK 4+ test report or HSK waiver proof (not required for English-taught programmes), citizenship documents for former Chinese citizens, self-introduction video (Chinese and English, max 3 minutes), other supporting materials, guardian certificate (under 18). Portfolio applies only to the Arts and Architecture divisions. Hard copies of the application form and transcripts are sent after the Comprehensive Assessment.
